summary: Researchers reason that water ice could survive for billions of years inside polar craters that never see sunlight.
title: Ice predicted in the shadows

summary: Clementine and then Lunar Prospector detect hydrogen signals at the poles — the first hint that water ice may be buried there.
title: First hints of hydrogen at the poles

summary: Chandrayaan-1, Cassini and Deep Impact find water spread across the surface, and the LCROSS impact throws up grains of water ice from a shadowed crater.
title: Water found — and excavated

summary: Data from Chandrayaan-1's Moon Mineralogy Mapper confirms water ice sitting inside permanently shadowed regions.
title: Ice confirmed in the shadows

summary: The SOFIA airborne observatory detects water on the Moon's sunlit surface, near the crater Clavius.
title: Water on the sunlit side

summary: SOFIA's water map extends toward the south pole — the region Artemis missions and the planned VIPER rover aim to explore.
title: The water map reaches the south pole
